state.key: JSON.stringify([aero, version, owning sessionId, explicit card id])

events.missing_owner: refuse send, never fall back to focused chat

wizard.description: Numbered steps with progress and Bantu/Sudah controls.

status.description: One row per label:state pair, dot coloured by state.

trace.description: Collapsible observed-work/evidence summary, never private reasoning.

compare.description: Two aligned columns; pick highlights left or right.

form.description: Labelled text inputs; submit sends values through the composer.

choice.description: Single or multiple choice interview; optional note, explicit owning-chat submit.

flow.description: Ordered visual process; click a stage to reveal its explanation locally.

chart.description: Nonnegative numeric bars, visible values, focus and equivalent data table.

interview.description: One bordered card with 1-4 radio groups; option 'title::explanation'; submit sends one owning-chat answer after every group is answered.

quiz.description: 1-5 single-answer questions; local state only: letter options, correct/incorrect after pick, optional explanation, Next, final score. Answer key is model-supplied teaching data, not a secret.

table.description: Headered data table; columns pipe-separated, rows pipe-separated with cells semicolon-separated.

map.description: Static OpenStreetMap tile grid (renderer-built 3x3 tiles) with labeled pins; places are name;lat;lon;note rows. Static only, never claims interactive-map parity.

limits.prompt_overflow: refuse with visible error, never truncate

fallback: Concise text; preview only when a separate verified HTML artifact is needed.
